entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A bold, fearless and unpredictable planeswalker several thousand years old, a Kor from Zendikar who spent much of that time in stasis.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker contemporary of Nahiri.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker contemporary of Nahiri.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's homeland, whose denizens are known for their adventurous spirit.

entities.name: The Kor
entities.description: A people of Zendikar known for adventurous spirit and lifestyles.

events.summary: Nahiri spends much of her several thousand years in stasis.
events.quote: Though she is several thousand years old, she spent much of that time in stasis

events.summary: Nahiri frequently sets aside traveling the Multiverse for the greater good of her homeland.
events.quote: Nahiri has frequently set aside traveling the Multiverse for the greater good of her homeland.

relations.note: The Kor are her people on Zendikar.
relations.quote: This may be because the Kor (and many of the denizens of Zendikar) are known for their adventurous spirit
